scope: Final deterministic and isolated performance remeasurement, plus the completed production preload build. Recovery and aggregate completion are recorded separately by the parent closeout ledger; no future or ongoing results are included here.

execution.sourceState: Deterministic and performance commands ran at clean bc7e4ad2d. The later production preload build used the same unchanged implementation; evidence-only normalization may have been present in the worktree during that build. No source or test changes were made by this normalization.
execution.isolation: Deterministic and performance commands ran sequentially; all other workers were paused for the performance measurements. Normalization occurred afterward while only non-timing recovery work resumed.

retention: All four structural artifacts, all three generation process artifacts (twelve dimensions each with every measured timing and work counter), all nine maintenance samples, and all twelve locale samples plus both shared script closures are retained unchanged. Warmups are described by their original metadata; discarded warmup timings were not emitted by the harness and are not fabricated. The full completed production initial-preload and bundle-boundaries artifacts are also retained, including all 392 emitted chunk records and their module memberships; their production closure accounting is separate from browser-smoke script closure accounting.

organization.budgetRule: 4096 bytes for ordinary scoped operations; reset retains the owning character chat bodies plus 2048 bytes. Each original per-fixture budget is retained in the raw samples.

generation.method: Analytical comparison after execution. Vitest asserts semantics and structural work budgets; RISU_GENERATION_COST_TIMING=1 records timings without asserting millisecond limits. Each of three fresh processes performs one unrecorded warmup and three recorded repetitions for each of twelve dimensions. Original timing limits are compared against the pooled median of all nine retained measurements per metric/dimension. Individual samples and per-process medians remain visible; none were discarded.
generation.limitsSource: generation-baseline.md: original small-unrelated 0.453/2.409 ms and large-unrelated 1.066/2.812 ms limits. No new timing gate is assigned to required history, configuration-row parsing or named legacy embedded storage.

maintenance.limitsSource: maintenance-baseline.md: original large median maximum event-loop/API limits are backup 7.924/8.142 ms and GC 16.117/16.576 ms, plus progress while unfinished.

locale.timingGate: No strict startup millisecond budget is inferred. Readiness timings are retained observations. The original runtime gate is distinct-script gzip strictly below 1393734 bytes, requested first label, background readiness and only the requested non-English pack. The separate production build gates retain the original initial HTML 194860-byte gzip target and immediate-startup gzip strictly below 1377316 bytes.

axes.small: Small metadata captures remain 126 bytes, cache responses capture only their 311-byte payload, and mutable outbox work clones each request once. Small generation timing meets the original envelope. Small backup completion has asynchronous overhead, while heartbeat and API progress remain explicit in every sample.
axes.scaling: Unrelated normalized generation corpus growth does not increase selected snapshots, aggregate clones or asset reads. Organization reset intentionally scales with the owning character histories. Required target history increases prompt assembly and retained selected snapshot work; this is separated from unrelated corpus growth.
axes.residual: Settings-row JSON parsing still grows with unused configuration records, and the named legacy embedded-character path still reads a larger settings row and captured configuration. Those residual dimensions retain all costs and have no silently broadened ordinary timing budget. Cache maintenance still enumerates cache state outside the resource-delivery dependency. Backup/GC still perform necessary SQLite/reference validation and bounded filesystem work. Locale startup still loads the shared application closure plus English and the selected pack.

environment.cacheState: Fresh temporary files each repetition; OS page cache is not flushed
environment.concurrency: One injected authenticated GET plus one setImmediate heartbeat
environment.memoryMethod: Samples at operation boundaries, recursive-copy completion, and heartbeat; heapUsed covers the API isolate, RSS includes native copy workers, and process maxRSS is lifetime high-water rather than per-operation peak
environment.phaseMethod: Real node:sqlite backup marks; post-snapshot includes reference scanning, all file copying, cleanup, and manifest; directoryCopy timings/counts cover recursive cp calls only, so bounded copyFile work is included in post-snapshot time even when directoryCopy is zero; createBackup does not run retention
